document.name: Kids at Work — Gentle Separation Preschool Prep
document.address: 147 W. 24th St. Second Floor, New York, NY 10011
document.shortDescription: Chelsea preschool-prep class for toddlers and twos, with weekday morning Gentle Separation groups that gradually build independence in a small classroom setting.
document.longDescription:
Kids at Work's Gentle Separation Preschool Prep program is an independence-building class for young children and their adults in Chelsea. The official program page says the class is designed for children ages 18 months to 2.7 years and uses a gradual separation process in a nurturing classroom with messy art, sensory play, meeting time, music, cooperative play, cooking, and snack.

The same page says each child and adult spend two days per week for two hours together in the classroom before adults gradually move to a separate waiting area, while remaining on site for the duration of class. Published schedule options at the West 24th location in Chelsea are Monday/Wednesday 9:15am-11:15am and Tuesday/Thursday 9:15am-11:15am, with an additional four-day Monday-Thursday enrollment option. Kids at Work describes the program as running throughout the year with Fall, Winter-Spring, Full Academic Year, and Summer semester options.

The official pricing section says each session requires a $1200 deposit to hold a child's spot. It also publishes Summer 2026 tuition of $3080 for 11 weeks, $3240 for 12 weeks, and $3380 for 13 weeks; 2026-2027 full-year tuition of $8860 for either the Monday/Wednesday or Tuesday/Thursday group and $16,720 for the four-day option; Fall 2026 semester pricing of $3770 for Monday/Wednesday, $3640 for Tuesday/Thursday, and $7010 for four-day enrollment; and Winter-Spring 2027 semester pricing of $5590 for Monday/Wednesday, $5720 for Tuesday/Thursday, and $10,910 for four-day enrollment. Contact details published on the page footer list 147 W. 24th St. Second floor in Manhattan, phone 212-488-8800, and email Info@kidsatworknyc.com.

Sources: https://www.kidsatworknyc.com/playgroup-gentle-separation/ https://www.kidsatworknyc.com/rates/
